flags.summary: A closer disengaged from a live prospect and offered to end the call because the prospect joined lying down on his phone, and defended that as the prospect's failure to earn help; the reviewing closer identified it as pride and the reason the call was lost.
evidence: I was like, this guy. If you're laying over, I would never join a call. Like, that's how he was laying there.
No, but seriously, usually I wouldn't even want to go at further than this. I would just be like, never mind.
they're laid out like this with a phone and I'm like, mate, you book in this meeting, you want to get help, I'm here to help you. But then also, actually show up professionally.
why is it their responsibility to show up professionally? Because they want help.
it seems like he doesn't give a [damn], so I don't even want to help him, I think it's that.
Yeah, but dude, that's very prideful, to be honest.
